description:
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ by paying {3}{B}.
When Last Voyage of the _____ enters, it triggers, returning Kederekt Leviathan from your graveyard to the battlefield with Last Voyage of the _____ attached.
When Kederekt Leviathan enters, it triggers, returning all nonland permanents to their owner's hands.
Last Voyage of the _____'s last ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kederekt Leviathan.
Repeat each turn.
